<quote by="Proposed: Miaren, Seconded: Bastion">Navarr marches to war with the vallorn. What will we be when it is destroyed? Here is an answer. To commission the Seren City of Dreams project. Self funded.</quote>
==Overview==
* Constructs the City of Dreams in Serenael, [[Miaren]] as per the '''[[Comes_a_time#The_City_of_Dreams|Comes a time]]''' wind of fortune.
* Passed

==Date==
* Summer 386YE

==Cost==
* Costs as per opportunity
* 90 weirwood
* 30 white granite
* 360 crowns
* Nine months to complete

==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|City_of_Dreams}}
==Outcome==
Once complete the City of Dreams will increase [[great work|investment]] in the congregations of Miaren by one, providing a vial of liao and a dose of [[Goosewhisper Infusion]] each season; the archetype of Dreamspeaker will be established in Navarr; and the title of ''Dreamer's Guide'' will be available to appoint by the National Assembly of Navarr.
